description: The prompt that rebuilds an item, written from its built files: the master prompt for a page, the section prompt for a section, the component prompt for a component, the dashboard prompt for an AI dashboard. Free items return the whole prompt; Pro items return the opening lines and how to open the rest.

id.description: The item's id from search: a page slug, a section (block) id, a component (motion) id or an AI dashboard (chat) slug

type.description: page, block (a page section), motion (an animated AI component or an AI platform screen) or chat (an AI dashboard)

name: get_prompt
title: Get the build prompt
